<?php
function isLucky($x) {
    if ($x <= 0) return false;
    while ($x > 0) {
        $d = $x % 10;
        if ($d != 4 && $d != 7) return false;
        $x = intdiv($x, 10);
    }
    return true;
}

list($n, $k) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));

$fact = [1];
$limit = min($n, 20);
for ($i = 1; $i <= $limit; $i++) {
    $fact[$i] = $fact[$i - 1] * $i;
    if ($fact[$i] > 1e18) $fact[$i] = 1e18;
}

if ($n <= 20 && $k > $fact[$n]) {
    echo "-1\n";
    exit;
}

$start = max(1, $n - 20 + 1);
$len = $n - $start + 1;

if ($k > $fact[$len]) {
    echo "-1\n";
    exit;
}

$used = array_fill(1, $n, false);
$perm = array_fill(1, $n, 0);

for ($i = 1; $i < $start; $i++) {
    $perm[$i] = $i;
    $used[$i] = true;
}

$avail = [];
for ($i = $start; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    $avail[] = $i;
}

$k--; // zero-based
for ($pos = $start; $pos <= $n; $pos++) {
    $remaining = $n - $pos;
    $block = ($remaining <= 20) ? $fact[$remaining] : 1e18;
    $idx = intdiv($k, $block);
    $k = $k % $block;
    $perm[$pos] = $avail[$idx];
    array_splice($avail, $idx, 1);
}

$luckyPositions = [];
for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    if (isLucky($i)) $luckyPositions[] = $i;
}

$ans = 0;
foreach ($luckyPositions as $i) {
    if ($i <= $n && isLucky($perm[$i])) $ans++;
}

echo $ans . "\n";
?>

<?php
function isLucky($x) {
    if ($x <= 0) return false;
    while ($x > 0) {
        $d = $x % 10;
        if ($d != 4 && $d != 7) return false;
        $x = intdiv($x, 10);
    }
    return true;
}

list($n, $k) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));
$MAX = 20;

if ($n <= $MAX) {
    $fact = array_fill(0, $MAX + 1, 1);
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $MAX; $i++) {
        $fact[$i] = $fact[$i - 1] * $i;
    }
    if ($k > $fact[$n]) {
        echo "-1\n";
        exit;
    }
    $k--; // 0-based
    $nums = range(1, $n);
    $perm = array();
    for ($pos = 1; $pos <= $n; $pos++) {
        $block = $fact[$n - $pos];
        $idx = intdiv($k, $block);
        $k %= $block;
        $perm[$pos] = $nums[$idx];
        array_splice($nums, $idx, 1);
    }
    $ans = 0;
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
        if (isLucky($i) && isLucky($perm[$i])) $ans++;
    }
    echo $ans . "\n";
    exit;
}

// n > MAX
$fact = array_fill(0, $MAX + 1, 1);
for ($i = 1; $i <= $MAX; $i++) {
    $fact[$i] = $fact[$i - 1] * $i;
}
$len = $n - $MAX;
if ($k > $fact[$MAX]) {
    echo "-1\n";
    exit;
}
$k--; // 0-based
$nums = range($len + 1, $n);
$permSuffix = array();
for ($pos = 1; $pos <= $MAX; $pos++) {
    $block = $fact[$MAX - $pos];
    $idx = intdiv($k, $block);
    $k %= $block;
    $permSuffix[$pos] = $nums[$idx];
    array_splice($nums, $idx, 1);
}

$ans = 0;
// positions 1..len: ai = i
for ($i = 1; $i <= $len; $i++) {
    if (isLucky($i)) $ans++;
}
// positions len+1..n: use permSuffix
for ($i = $len + 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    $ai = $permSuffix[$i - $len];
    if (isLucky($i) && isLucky($ai)) $ans++;
}
echo $ans . "\n";
?>

function isLucky($x) {
    if ($x <= 0) return false;
    while ($x > 0) {
        $d = $x % 10;
        if ($d != 4 && $d != 7) return false;
        $x = intdiv($x, 10);
    }
    return true;
}

list($n, $k) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));

$MAX_FACT = 20;
$fact = array_fill(0, $MAX_FACT + 1, 1);
for ($i = 1; $i <= $MAX_FACT; $i++) {
    $fact[$i] = $fact[$i - 1] * $i;
}

$len = min($n, $MAX_FACT);
if ($k > $fact[$len]) {
    echo "-1\n";
    exit;
}

$start = $n - $len + 1;
$perm = [];
for ($i = 0; $i < $len; $i++) {
    $perm[$i] = $start + $i;
}

for ($pos = 0; $pos < $len; $pos++) {

    if ($block > 0) {
        $idx = intdiv($k, $fact[$block]);
        $k = $k % $fact[$block];
